events.title: Tiny Demo Update: 0.8.3
events.summary: Tiny update:Smiley Machine now opens a tad more snappy with enhanced animation & added SFXDr. Folman has added a few 'Notes' in regards to "Air-strafing" / "Air Control" ( To hint new 'Players', not familiar with the specific mechanic of this genre and who kept getting stuck, on what to do )Stopwatch, fixed the 'Bell' model to not get stuck ( For some players ) when It's off.Just a tiny update to address some frustrations. Thanks to everyone playing!

events.title: Demo Updated - V.0.8.0
events.summary: Clocking in with the new Timer!'The Pit' now has a Timer, at the bottom, where you can clock in to work, timing your shift. Your times are saved in a local leaderboard! (The full game is planned to feature a global leaderboard) Other:'Crouch' have been overhauled and should now be more stable ( And less prone to poke your head through the world.'Start Area' + 'Physical Agility' level adjustments:Removed "Sound Machines" as it confused some PlayersAdded an additional route to 'Control Room'Lot's
